summary: A compact, playable beat with a clear turn: Shalabi gives the men a tactical reason for confidence, their restrained answer shows discipline, and Sayed quietly exposes the cost of failure. The language, military register and low-volume staging suit concealed, exhausted commandos.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Crouched among the nearest men, he makes brief eye contact instead of addressing them theatrically. Admit the odds without self-pity, then tighten slightly on «مَا يِعْرَفُوشْ» as the tactical advantage.

lines.text: يَا رِجَّالَةْ… هُمَّ كْتِيرْ، وِإِحْنَا قُلَيِّلِينْ. بَسّْ مَا يِعْرَفُوشْ إِحْنَا فِينْ.

lines.speaker: COMMANDOS

performance.delivery: Two or three nearby men answer separately, not as a rehearsed chorus. Each keeps his body down and gives Shalabi only enough voice to show he is ready.

lines.text: تَمَامْ يَا فَنْدِمْ… إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهْ.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Say it only to Mostafa, almost without turning toward him. Sayed is not spreading panic; he is making sure the younger man understands what the calm briefing really means.

lines.text: اللِّوَا دَهْ لَوْ عَدَّى… يِبْقَى إِحْنَا كُلِّنَا رُحْنَا.
